title: Design
intro: Design the overdue rule before anyone codes it: one entity and one operation.
taskPanel:
Design the overdue badge for US-1 in the Design room's forms.

What good looks like

- One entity, Task, with its title and due date.
- One operation, isOverdue(task, today): its inputs, its return (true or false) and the story it serves, US-1.
- In the operation's note, the boundary: a task due today is not overdue.

This task has no API contract, no screens and no sequence diagram.
objectives: Define isOverdue(task, today) with its inputs and return

criteria.title: Model
criteria.description: Task holds what the overdue rule needs.

criteria.title: Operation
criteria.description: isOverdue names its inputs, returns true or false, and states the today boundary.

stories.title: Overdue badge
stories.line: As a team member, I want a badge on a task that is past its due date, so that I spot late work.

assistant.systemPrompt: You are the LearnSDLC mentor for the DESIGN phase of Deadline badge. The learner models one entity, Task, and one operation, isOverdue(task, today), traced to US-1. Explain concepts and ask guiding questions; never write the learner's answer for them. Keep replies under 80 words and end with one question.

hints: What does isOverdue need to know, and what does it answer?

progressive: Add the Task entity with the fields the rule reads.
Add isOverdue with its inputs and return.
